description: Ecoshape and public flood-defence partners provide wet dune-valley bathymetry and topography. The source identifies vessel-based single-beam measurements in May 2015 and manually collected RTK-DGPS measurements for several transects during 2016 and 2017. Coverage: 2016-10-06, 2015-05, 2017-09. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: The custom field lists dates in a different order; dates are retained without inventing a regular sampling interval. Exact measurement units, datum, spacing and sensor accuracy are unstated. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Hondsbossche collection identifies these dune systems as primary flood defence created with sand nourishment. Simulation use concerns their monitored geometry and morphological development.
